passive.text: Increases Anomaly Proficiency by **96/105/115/125/135**. When the equipper triggers a **Refringe** reaction, they gain **20/23/26/29/32%** increased Anomaly DMG, and all squad members gain **30/34.5/39/43.5/48%** increased DMG dealt. Both effects last 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

When the equipper triggers a **Refringe** reaction, they gain **20/23/26/29/32%** increased Anomaly DMG, and all squad members gain **30/34.5/39/43.5/48%** increased DMG dealt. Both effects last 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Lingering Cries
passive.text: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper gains a buff that increases Anomaly Proficiency by **30/34/38/42/48**, stacking up to 4 times. This effect expires when the target recovers from Stun or is defeated. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

substatLine: ATK% (until 4000 in statscreen) > Anomaly Proficiency > PEN
skillPriority: Chain Attack > Basic Attack > Assist > Special Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Leap
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs up to four attacks ahead, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
If the Basic Attack hits the target, gains Floating Radiance after the skill ends.
After the 4th hit of the Basic Attack ends, 1 **Lumiflux Buildup** is applied to enemies hit.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Solo Dance
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack to activate:
Performs a slash in an area ahead, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
If it hits a target, gains **Floating Radiance** after the skill ends.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Rainbow's End
entries.text:
When Remielle has stored Voidflare, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
Grants a large amount of **Floating Radiance** when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, triggers the Luminize effect after the skill ends with a **160%** multiplier.
Consumes all stored **Voidflare** upon use.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace
entries.text:
When Remielle has stored **Voidflare** and is in the **Luminous Reflection** state, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
Grants a large amount of **Floating Radiance** when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, triggers the **Luminize** effect after the skill ends with a **320%** multiplier.
Consumes all stored **Voidflare** upon use.

entries.name: Dodge: Retreating Light
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Keen Light
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Launches a quick attack ahead, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Mirrored Shadow
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at the target, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Featherglow Rebirth
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Unleashes a slash at the target, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Fleeting Light
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Awakening Glimmer
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Unleashes a series of slashes against the target, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist: Flower & Feather Dance
entries.text:
Enters the battlefield and unleashes an attack in a large area, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
Consumes 40 Floating Radiance upon activation. With 90 or fewer **Floating Radiance** remaining upon activation, this **Assist: Flower & Feather Dance** does not consume **Floating Radiance**. Remielle also enters the **Luminous Reflection** state, and the next **Basic Attack: Rainbow's End** is upgraded to **Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace**.
When this skill hits a Stunned enemy, their Stun duration is extended by 3s. Each enemy can be affected by this effect only once per Stun window. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with other effects of the same type.
If this skill lands a hit, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of **320%**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Sliver of Light
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Launches a ranged attack ahead, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Ode to Dawn
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, if Remielle has less than 60 Energy, her Energy is recovered to 60. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
After the skill ends, apply 2 **Lumiflux Buildup** to all enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
entries.text:
When Remielle is in combat and her **Floating Radiance** reaches its maximum of 120, hold Special Attack after a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack** to enter **Stance Shift**. Switching characters while in **Stance Shift** causes Remielle to enter the **Phase Flow** state:
While in the **Phase Flow** state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. In this state, **Floating Radiance** is consumed over time, and some of her attacks apply **Lumiflux Buildup** to the target. When **Floating Radiance** is fully depleted or upon leaving combat, Remielle exits the **Phase Flow** state. Before exiting the **Phase Flow** state, Remielle cannot be actively switched in except via a **Chain Attack**.
If Remielle triggers 3 Refringe reactions in one **Phase Flow** state, or has at least 1 stored Voidflare when **Floating Radiance** is fully depleted, **Assist: Flower & Feather Dance** becomes available, and her normal switch-in is unlocked. **Assist: Flower & Feather Dance** is automatically used on Remielle's next normal switch-in.
Upon entering the **Phase Flow** state, Remielle increases all squad members's DMG by **18%** for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Remielle's **Floating Radiance** has reached its maximum of 120 and her **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack** hits a Stunned enemy, she can also enter the **Phase Flow** state by switching characters during the **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**.
If no character is switched in after entering **Stance Shift**, Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground instead.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Interwoven Dance Steps
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple attacks ahead in a large area, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
Enters the **Luminous Reflection** state upon activation. The next **Basic Attack: Rainbow's End** is upgraded to **Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace**.
After the skill ends, apply 2 **Lumiflux Buildup** to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Launches an attack across a large area in front, dealing **Lumiflux DMG**.
If the skill hits, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of **336%**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors
entries.text:
Remielle's **Refringe Coefficient** is equal to 0.02% of her Anomaly Proficiency. If there are 3 **Anomaly** characters in the squad, her **Refringe Coefficient** increases by an additional 10%.
When Remielle triggers a Refringe reaction through a teammate, she generates **Voidflare** based on the enhanced Anomaly Effect Strength of the current Attribute Anomaly after it has been **Refringed**. Up to the 3 most recently generated **Voidflares** can be stored.
If **Assist: Flower & Feather Dance**, **Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call**, **Basic Attack: Rainbow's End**, or **Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace** hits a target, **Luminize** is triggered after the skill ends：
Based on the **Anomaly Effect Strength** of all stored **Voidflares**, deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to the enemy using the corresponding skill's DMG multiplier. This multiplier is further increased by **0.2%** of Remielle's Anomaly Proficiency.
All stored **Voidflares** are cleared when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state or after using **Basic Attack: Rainbow's End** or **Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace**.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Invitation to Bloom
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Anomaly** character or shares the same faction:
When there are 1/2/3 **Anomaly** characters in the squad, upon entering the battlefield, all squad members gain an ATK increase equal to 6%/12%/40% of Remielle's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 1,600 ATK. Remielle's Daze dealt while in the Phase Flow state increases by 6%/12%/35%.
When applying **Lumiflux Buildup** to an enemy, Remielle also applies the **Prismatic** effect: All squad members' attacks against enemies with the **Prismatic** effect have 15% increased Anomaly Buildup Rate. **Prismatic** is removed when the enemy no longer has **Lumiflux Buildup**. After **Prismatic** is removed, the Anomaly Buildup Rate increase persists for an additional 8s.

entries.name: Naive Oath
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflares. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Remielle triggers Luminize to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES.
When using **Assist: Flower & Feather Dance**, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.

entries.name: Fall Into the Noise
entries.text:
Remielle's **Refringe Coefficient** increases by 20%.
When an **Anomaly** character in the squad deals Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by **Prismatic**, the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after **Prismatic** ends.
While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, the frequency at which she automatically attacks to apply **Lumiflux Buildup** to enemies increases.

entries.name: The Garden of Diverging Time
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: The Long Goodbye
entries.text:
When Remielle triggers Luminize, the DMG multiplier is increased by an additional 12%.
After entering the battlefield and gaining 3 special Voidflares, if all **Voidflares** are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special **Voidflares** again. This effect to regain special **Voidflares** is removed after being triggered once or when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state.

entries.name: To Drink Forgetfulness
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Lone Feather's Endless Flight
entries.text:
When Remielle uses **Basic Attack: Rainbow's End** or **Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace**, Luminize is triggered 2 times.
If the 4th hit of her **Basic Attack** lands against a target, Remielle gains 3 special **Voidflares** after the skill ends. Special Voidflares gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special **Voidflares** gained upon entering the battlefield.
